name: Pentapro Materials Inc.
summary: Pentapro Materials Inc. manufactures and sells organometallic precursors and fine chemicals. The company's products include cyclohexane, carbon tetrabromide, bromotrichloromethane, antimony trioxide, trimethylgallium, trisilylamine, diethylaluminium ethoxide, triethylaluminum, trimethylindium, diethylzinc, cyclohexane, triethylantimony, and trimethylaluminum. It also provides bubbler and testing services. The company serves semiconductor, solar energy, monitor, and optical communication industries. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.
